scope: Exact G1 plus bilateral Sharpa full-q analysis-by-synthesis bridge on the real 27.5-second candidate
summary: The new exact-asset solver, validator, compiler bridge, and adversarial tests work, but the real single view cannot identify all 73 robot joints and has no foundation-keypoint plus exact-render bundle, so no robot trajectory is emitted.
evidence: The exact asset files match the frozen registry and contribute 29 G1, 22 left-Sharpa, and 22 right-Sharpa scalar joints.
The real validation finishes in 0.008898959 seconds with status PARTIAL and robot_trajectory=null.
Manual full-span review finds the lower body outside the frame, most finger joints occluded by flowers, the exact generated embodiment unverified, and late color/local-structure corruption.

The bounded LM solver uses data-Jacobian rank and condition number rather than priors for observability; wrong hash, infinite q uncertainty, ambiguous asset, missing held-out groups, and partial-q attacks are rejected.
Ten new exact-asset tests pass, and the 35-test related foundation-contact suite passes with Python warnings treated as errors.
lessons: A complete numeric q vector is not full-q evidence when cropped or occluded dimensions are supplied only by a prior.
Asset hashes prove which files a renderer should use; held-out render comparison and alternative-asset separation are still required to prove generated embodiment identity.
limitations: The current video provides neither synchronized robot telemetry nor a calibrated additional view of the cropped legs and occluded fingers.
MediaPipe imports in both Python 3.14 and Python 3.12 environments failed to complete within 60 seconds and were interrupted without producing landmarks; no replacement landmarks were fabricated.
Metric camera, persistent rods, and sensor/solver force stages remain false, so the result does not validate 3-D force closure or the final video.
next_actions: Acquire synchronized complete robot q/qdot telemetry or a calibrated additional view, run an occlusion-aware pretrained proposal model, and feed its dense observations through the frozen exact-render evidence contract.
Keep the trajectory gate false until all 660 frames, posterior bounds, held-out groups, and alternative-asset tests pass.
